blocks.text: We are under way on the retiree medical valuation, and the one thing that would help most right now is the last of the data. Amanda White on our side has reconciled the census extract your office sent, and it ties out well. What is still open is the plan document set and the current retiree contribution schedule, which we need before we can fix the plan provisions the measurement runs on. Once those are in, Amanda White can close out the census exhibits and we can move to setting assumptions.

One open item is really about scope rather than data, and Jennifer Vasquez is handling it so you get one considered answer instead of three partial ones: whether the valuation should reflect the plan as it stands today or as amended for the change your board discussed. A pointer on that when you have it is plenty.

So our file stays complete, we log everything you send against your name, Jason Wagner, and the date it arrives, which is how we document what the {{fact:f:E-2020-001.client}} measurement relies on. If it is easier to route the plan documents through someone on your staff, just tell me who and I will follow up with them directly.
